text: Decision: the team standardised on pnpm as the package manager for every workspace in the monorepo. npm and yarn lockfiles are forbidden and must be deleted on sight.
Decision: session tokens are stored only in HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookies. Storing a session token in localStorage is a security defect and fails review.
Gotcha: pnpm does not hoist transitive dependencies into the root node_modules by default. Code that imported a package it never declared must add it as a direct dependency.
fact: pnpm does not hoist transitive dependencies by default

text: Decision: all backend services log through the shared @tetis-lair/tetis-logger library. It pretty-prints in development and emits structured JSON in production for log aggregation.

Root cause: the nightly CI job flaked because the integration suite bound a fixed port and a leftover process held it. Fix: allocate an ephemeral port per run and wait for readiness before driving the server.
fact: a leftover process holding a fixed port

text: Decision: database migrations are forward-only. Rolling back is done by writing a new forward migration, never by editing or reverting an applied one.
Constraint: the public HTTP API is versioned in the URL path under /v1. Breaking changes require a new version prefix; the old prefix stays live for two release cycles.
Gotcha: all timestamps are stored and compared in UTC. A bug where reports were off by a day traced to a server that formatted dates in local time before persisting them.
Decision: the repository runs its unit and integration test suite on the vitest test runner. Jest was removed to avoid maintaining two runners and two config dialects.
Decision: the recall cache uses a 300 second TTL in Redis. The value was chosen to match the prompt-cache window so a warm context survives a typical agent turn.
Decision: all committed repository content is written in English. Code comments, docs, and commit messages must be English; chat with the maintainer may use other languages, the repo may not.
Constraint: secrets are injected only through environment variables at deploy time. Committing a secret to the repository, even in a test fixture, is a hard failure of the security gate.
Decision: checkout-worker deploys on the atlas-runner platform. The service record names only the platform, not the production region.
Decision: atlas-runner locality code is us-east-1. Locality codes are maintained separately from named services.
Decision: billing-cron deploys on the harbor-runner platform. The service record names only the platform, not the production region.
Decision: harbor-runner locality code is eu-west-1. Locality codes are maintained separately from named services.
Original decision: the checkout API retry attempt limit was 3 attempts. This policy was active before the January 2026 reliability review.
Current decision: the checkout API retry attempt limit is 5 attempts as of the January 2026 reliability review. This supersedes the old retry limit.
